title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud af kontrakt om it-arbejdspladser, enhedsadministration og servicedesk
description: Danmarks Nationalbank (”Nationalbanken”) er Danmarks centralbank. Nationalbankens virksomhed bygger på lov om Danmarks Nationalbank fra 1936, hvorefter Nationalbanken har til opgave at opretholde et sikkert pengevæsen i Danmark samt at lette og regulere pengeomsætning og kreditgivning. Denne opgavebeskrivelse er fortsat dækkende for Nationalbankens rolle og ansvar som centralbank. Nationalbanken varetager en række samfundskritiske opgaver, herunder drift og overvågning af kritisk betalingsinfrastruktur samt udøvelse af centrale pengepolitiske funktioner. De processer, systemer og data, der understøtter disse opgaver, er af afgørende betydning for den finansielle stabilitet og tilliden til det danske finansielle system. Nationalbankens forretningsmæssige behov skal sikre, at kontrakten understøtter et højt niveau af leverancesikkerhed, robusthed og kontinuitet i leveringen af Ydelserne. Leverandøren forventes derfor at udvise en proaktiv tilgang til såvel den daglige leverance som til håndtering af risici, forbedringsmuligheder og teknologisk udvikling. Nationalbanken har et højt fokus på informationssikkerhed, og Leverandøren skal sikre et sikkerhedsniveau, der svarer til det, som findes hos sammenlignelige organisationer med et tilsvarende trusselsbillede. Nationalbankens sikkerhedskrav gælder for alle leverancer og aktiviteter, der udføres for eller på vegne af Nationalbanken som led i leveringen af Kontraktens Ydelser. Dette stiller høje krav til sikkerhed, robusthed og operationel modstandsdygtighed. På den baggrund stilles der krav om, at Leverandøren under hele kontraktperioden skal være certificeret efter ISO/IEC 27001:2022 eller en tilsvarende international standard. Derudover stiller Kontrakten krav om at Leverandøren efterlever SWIFT CSP krav og kan dokumentere denne efterlevelse overfor både Nationalbanken og SWIFT. Nationalbanken anvender som udgangspunkt Microsoft-baserede teknologier og værktøjer i sin IT-arkitektur og systemunderstøttelse. Endvidere baseres Service Delivery Management på ITIL v3-principper og -processer. Kontrakten har til formål at etablere et leverandørsamarbejde om levering af services relateret til it-arbejdspladser, enhedsadministration, Onsitesupport og servicedesk. IT-arbejdspladsen omfatter bl.a. leverance og support af stationære computere, bærbare computere, og periferiudstyr samt servicedesk-funktioner og relaterede drifts- og supportydelser. Derudover support af tablets og smartphones. Nationalbanken har i forbindelse med implementeringen af Windows 11 gennemført en større udskiftning af ældre enheder, hvilket har medført en betydelig modernisering af Nationalbankens PC-portefølje. Der er tale om en high-end PC model, der udleveres til alle medarbejdere og eksterne konsulenter. Leverandøren skal i den forbindelse erhverve ejerskab til visse aktiver (hardware). Leverandøren skal fungere som central kontaktflade (Single Point of Contact) for de omfattede ydelser og indgå i et tæt samarbejde med Nationalbankens interne funktioner, Nationalbankens Service Integrator og øvrige leverandører. Nationalbanken anvender et multileverandør-setup og Leverandøren skal derfor understøtte effektiv integration og samarbejde med øvrige leverandører, herunder relevante service management-processer og værktøjer. Kunden stiller Kundens ITSM-løsning til rådighed for Leverandøren til brug for efterfølgende levering af ydelserne. Leverandøren skal anvende Nationalbankens ITSM-løsning til de processer, sagsregistreringer, vidensartikler, opdateringer og aktiviteter, som Nationalbanken anviser. Ligeledes stiller Nationalbanken en samarbejdsplatform til rådighed for Leverandøren til brug for samarbejdet mellem Nationalbanken og Leverandøren. Leverandøren kan blive mødt med krav om iagttagelse af virksomhedsoverdragelsesloven.

title: Externer Informationssicherheitsbeauftragter für den Brandenburgischen IT-Dienstleister
description: Der Brandenburgische IT-Dienstleister (ZIT-BB) ist der zentrale Dienstleister für die unmittelbare Landesverwaltung Brandenburg zur Bereitstellung von IT-Dienstleistungen. Zu seinem umfangreichen Aufgabenportfolio gehören u.a. die Planung, die Bereitstellung und der Betrieb der technischen Infrastruktur sowie die Koordination und die Betreuung sowohl von behördenspezifischen als auch behördenübergreifenden und gemeinsamen IT-Verfahren. In seinen Aufgabenbereich fallen auch das IT-Sicherheitsmanagement für die IT-Infrastruktur der Landesverwaltung und die Zuständigkeit für das Computer-Emergency-Response-Team (CERT). Der ZIT-BB betreut von seinem zentralen Standort Potsdam aus derzeit ca. 18.000 Arbeitsplätze in der Landesverwaltung Brandenburg. Die Anzahl der zu betreuenden Arbeitsplätze wird in den kommenden Jahren weiter ansteigen. Mit der Zentralisierung der IT der Landesverwaltung ist die Unterstützung der Behörden und Einrichtungen des Landes Brandenburg bei der Planung, der Gestaltung und dem Einsatz von Informationstechnik sowie die Beratung in Fragen der IT-Sicherheit zu einem wesentlichen Tätigkeitsfeld des Betriebs geworden. Ferner erbringt der ZIT-BB Leistungen nach dem Brandenburgischen E-Government-Gesetz insbesondere für Gemeinden, Ämter und Gemeindeverbände des Landes. Der Hauptstandort des ZIT-BB befindet sich in der Steinstraße 104-106 in 14480 Potsdam. Aufgrund seiner landesweiten Zuständigkeit hat der ZIT-BB u.a. Außenstandorte in Cottbus, Frankfurt (Oder), Wünsdorf, Gransee und Eberswalde. Sein Rechenzentrum betreibt er in Berlin.

title: Fachplanung HLS
description: Das Medizinische Zentrum für Gesundheit Bad Lippspringe GmbH (MZG Westfalen) plant die energetische Sanierung sowie weitere bauliche Maßnahmen der Einrichtung Martinusquelle mit Thermalschwimmbad und Sporthalle. Wesentliche Teile des Vorhabens zur energetischen Sanierung befinden sich bereits im Zuge von geförderten Maßnahmen (EFRE) in der Planung. Weitere Baumaßnahmen sollen nun folgen. Dies betrifft Umbauten in verschiedenen Bauteilen (z.B. Umbau Therapiebereiche, Büros, Sanierung Dachflächen) sowie die Umgestaltung des Haupteinganges. Die Einrichtung Martinusquelle wird während der gesamten Umbauphase voll in Betrieb sein, und alle Patienten werden weiterhin vor Ort sein. Die Sanierung erfolgt abschnittsweise. Die Gebäudeteile, die von der Sanierung betroffen sind, werden im Rahmen der Projektrealisierung leer gezogen und können dann in einem Zug saniert werden. Gegenstand der hier angefragten Leistungen sind Planungsleistungen für Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär (Grundleistungen der HOAI, Leistungsphasen 1-8, §53 ff. HOAI i.V.m. Anlage 15): - Abwasser-, Wasser- und Gasanlagen, - Wärmeversorgungsanlagen, - Lufttechnische Anlagen, - Gebäudeautomation. Teile der Maßnahmen befinden sich bereits in unterschiedlichen Planungsphasen. Daher sind nicht alle Leistungsphasen Bestandteil der angefragten Leistungen. Folgende Leistungsphasen sind Gegenstand des zu vergebenden Auftrages: - Umbau/Neubau Haupteingang: Leistungsphasen 1 bis 8, - Weitere Umbaubereiche: Leistungsphasen 4 bis 8. Die bereits laufenden Maßnahmen sind teilweise gefördert (EFRE). Es ist auf die strikte Trennung geförderter und nicht geförderter Maßnahmen zu achten, insbesondere bei Aufmaß und Abrechnung. Die Kosten sind nach DIN 276 auf der 3. Ebene anzugeben. Wegen der weiteren Einzelheiten wird insbesondere auf die Leistungsbeschreibung (Teil B) und den Planervertrag (Teil C) verwiesen.

title: Udbud af Interiør og Isoleringsarbejder på Søværnets Skibe
description: Rammeaftalen vedrører interiør- og isoleringsarbejder på Søværnets skibe, og omfatter løbende modifikation og reparation ombord på skibene. Denne type arbejder skal ofte foregå hurtigt og effektivt, så skibenes beredskab påvirkes mindst muligt. Som følge heraf har Forsvaret brug for ekstern assistance til interiør- og isoleringsarbejder, som kan igangsættes med kort varsel når behovet opstår. En del af arbejdet vil foregå i samarbejde med andre typer håndværkere, eksempelvis malere, elektrikere, smede, stilladsarbejdere og kranførere. Ydelsen består af reparationsarbejder og modifikationsarbejder på Søværnets skibe samt tilhørende adkomstarbejder. Reparationsarbejder kan være udbedring af skader på inventar, reparation og udskiftning af loft- eller garneringsplader, samt lakeringsopgaver på træ. Modifikation kan være ændring af nuværende inventar løsninger, samt nyfremstilling af beslag, vugger, opbevaringsløsninger, eller montering af færdige løsninger. Leverandøren skal levere ydelser inden for 3D-scanning og 3D-print til støtte for opmåling, dokumentation, vedligeholdelse og fremstilling af komponenter. Adkomstarbejder defineres som aktiviteter, som muliggør de primære modifikationer af aptering på skibets skrog og/eller overbygning, dvs. demontage af komponenter og kabler, som er i vejen for arbejdet og genmontage af samme komponenter samt retablering af maling. Desuden skal rammeaftalen omfatte afledte arbejdsaktiviteter, som er nødvendige for at kunne udføre selve interiør- og/eller isoleringsarbejdet, dvs. opstilling af stillads og kranassistance o.lign. Det er et krav, at Leverandøren er sikkerhedsgodkendt på virksomhedsniveau, samt har sikkerhedsgodkendt personel til udførelse af aftalens opgaver, på tidspunktet for tilbudsafgivelsen. Det anses ikke, at perioden fra tilbudsafgivelse til aftalens underskrift er lang nok til, at manglende sikkerhedsgodkendelser kan tilvejebringes.

title: Germany – Tanks, reservoirs, containers and pressure vessels – RV über die Herstellung und Lieferung von bis zu 3.700 Tankcontainern Kraftstoffe (TCK) 9 m³
description: Es wird beabsichtigt, eine Rahmenvereinbarung (RV) mit einem Unternehmen über die Herstellung und Lieferung von bis zu 3.700 Tankcontainern Kraftstoffe (TCK) 9 m³ zu schließen inklusive Sonderwerkzeugsatz, Mess- und Prüfmittel, Ersatzteilerstbedarf, Einsatzvorrat an Ersatz- und Austauschteilen (ET/ AT) 30 Tage Landesverteidigung/ Bündnisverteidigung (LV/BV), Dokumentation inklusive nachbaufähigen Zeichnungsunterlagen sowie Erstausbildung von Ausbildungs- und Instandsetzungspersonal und Unterstützungsleistungen. Es ist eine Gesamtvergabe vorgesehen. Die Laufzeit der Rahmenvereinbarung soll 15 Jahre betragen. Bei den TCK 9 m³ handelt es sich um eine Gefahrgutum-schließung, die der Lagerung, dem Transport und Umschlag von Kraftstoffen dient. Im Verbund mit geeigneten Mobilitätsträgern (geländegängige vierachsige-Lastkraftwagen der Zuladungs-klasse 15 t, mit ADR- Zulassung und Twist-Lock-Aufnahme und / oder Hakenliftsystem) dient der TCK 9 m³ zur Versorgung von Endverbrauchern in urbanen und schwer zugänglichen Geländeabschnitten mit Kraftstoffen unter gleichzeitiger Einhaltung aller umweltrechtlichen Auflagen. Der TCK 9 m³ kann sowohl im aufgesetzten (auf Lkw) als auch im abgesetzten Betrieb (als autarkes Stand-Alone-Gerät) betrieben werden. Der TCK 9 m³ besteht aus einem doppelwandigem Tankkörper, einer Kraftstoffpumpanlage mit zwei Abgabeeinrichtungen, einem Stromerzeugeraggregat, sowie der rechtlich vorgeschriebenen Gefahrgutausstattung, die in einem 20 Fuß-ISO-Rahmen integriert ist. Bei Vertragsschluss sollen 602 EA fest beauftragt werden. Es ist ein Vorseriengerät TCK 9 m³ zu liefern. Die Lieferung des Vorseriengeräts TCK 9 m³ ist innerhalb von 9 Monaten nach Vertragsschluss zur Durchführung der Integrierten Nachweisführung vorgesehen. Zudem wird in der Rahmenvereinbarung die Lieferung folgender Leistungen vereinbart: - Muster-Sonderwerkzeugsatz - Ersatzteilerstbedarf - Einsatzvorrat an Ersatz- und Austauschteilen (ET/AT) LV/BV (30 Tage) - notwendige Mess- und Prüfmittel - Materialgrundlagen; hierzu zählen Sicherheitsdatenblätter, Stücklisten, nachbaufähige Zeichnungsunterlagen, Artikelstammdaten, Interaktive Elektronische Technische Dokumentation - Ausbildungsunterlagen - Prüf-/Abnahmedokumentation - Managementleistungen - Personalausbildung - Begleitung der Integrierten Nachweisführung Die TCK 9 m³ müssen für den Bundeswehr-Einsatz im Wesentlichen die nachfolgenden Forderungen erfüllen. Diese Übersicht dient dabei nur einer ersten Projektvorstellung. Die genauen Spezifikationen werden den Bietern nach erfolgreichem Nachweis der Eignung und Zulassung zur Angebotsphase übermittelt: - Kraftstoffnutzvolumen Tankkörper mindestens 9.000 Liter - Zulässige Gesamtmasse: 15.000 Kilogramm - Länge/Breite/Höhe: 20 Fuss / 8 Fuss / kleiner gleich 8 Fuss - Doppelwandiger Tankkörper mit Leckageüberwachung - Integrierte Kraftstoffpumpanlage mit zwei Abgabeeinrichtungen und einer Schlauchlänge von jeweils 20 Metern - Volumenstrom an den beiden Abgabeeinrichtungen mindestens 120 Liter pro Minute bei gleichzeitiger Abgabe -Befüll-/Entleeranschluss über 3 Zoll Industrietrockenkupplung gemäß STANAG 3756 - Uneingeschränkte Transportierbarkeit per Land-, Schienen- und Seeweg im befüllten Zustand - Transport-/Umschlagmöglichkeit mit in der Bundeswehr eingeführten Trägerfahrzeuge (20 Fuß Twist-Locks und/oder LKW mit Hakenliftsystem nach DIN 30722-2) - Zulassung für den Transport und Umschlag der Kraftstoffe F-34, F-35, F-63, F-75, F-44 und handelsüblicher Dieselkraftstoff nach DIN EN 590 bzw. F54 - uneingeschränkter Einsatz in Gebieten der Klimazonen A1 bis A3, B1 bis B3, C0 bis C1 gemäß STANAG 4370 i. V. m. title: Kirjallisuuden hankinta
description: Pirkanmaan kirjastojen yhteistoimintasopimukseen sitoutuneiden kuntien yleiset kirjastot (PIKI-kirjastot) ovat tilanteessa, joissa painetun kirjallisuuden hankintasopimukset ovat päättymässä, ja uusi kilpailutus on ajankohtainen. Kuntien yhteinen tahtotila on kilpailuttaa painetun kirjallisuuden hankinta PIKI-kirjastojen yhteisenä hankintarenkaana. Tampereen kaupunki valmistelee hankintaa PIKI-kirjastojen yhteistoiminta-sopimuksen mukaisesti. Kyseessä on hankintalain 26 § 1 mom. 2-kohdassa säädetyn EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä tavarahankinta, joka toteutetaan julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista annetun lain (1397/2016) 32 §:n mukaisena avoimena menettelynä. Kyseessä on usean toimittajan puitejärjestely. Hankinta on jaettu suomenkielisen ja muunkielisen kirjallisuuden osa-alueisiin. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan viisi (5) toimittajaa tarjousten vertailussa muodostuvan etusijajärjestyksen mukaisesti. Mikäli osa-alueella on vähemmän kuin viisi (5) soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttävää tarjoajaa tai hyväksyttävää tarjousta, puitejärjestelyyn valitaan kaikki kyseisen osa-alueen soveltuvuusvaatimukset täyttäneet tarjoajat, jotka ovat jättäneet tarjouspyynnön mukaisen hyväksyttävän tarjouksen. . Kokonaistaloudellisen edullisuuden perusteet (arviointikriteerit) on esitetty tässä tarjouspyynnössä liitteessä Vertailukriteerit. Sopimuskaudella hankinta tapahtuu pääosin hankintaportaalin kautta; portaali vertailee kunkin yksittäisen hankinnan hintoja ja ohjaa tilauksen sille toimittajalle, joka tarjoaa sen edullisimpaan hintaan., Suomenkielinen kirjallisuus Suomenkielisessä kirjallisuuden osa-alueessa tarjonnan tulee yleisen kirjallisuuden lisäksi sisältää laaja valikoima julkisten organisaatioiden, erilaisten yritysten ja yhdistysten ja muiden pien- ja omakustantajien tuotantoa. Lisäksi tulee tarjota kotimaisia nuotteja ja karttoja., Muunkielinen kirjallisuus Muunkielinen kirjallisuus on muuta kuin suomenkielistä ja Suomessa kustannettua kirjallisuutta. Muunkielisessä kirjallisuudessa tarjonnan tulee olla riittävän laaja ja monipuolinen. Tilaajalla on halutessaan oikeus hankkia ulkomaisia nuotteja ja karttoja sopimuksen kautta.,

description: The scope of this tender is to procure a framework agreement, which enables DMI to purchase meteorological weather balloons over a four-year period. The weather balloons will be used for radiosonde measurements which will be conducted from DMI’s manually operated radiosonde stations (four in Greenland and three established onboard ships sailing between Denmark and Greenland). title: Ilmanpuhdistuslaitteiden vuokraus ja hankinta
description: Vantaan kaupunki pyytää tarjouksia ilmanpuhdistimien vuokraamisesta ja hankinnasta. Hankinnan kohteena ovat vuokrattavat ja ostettavat sisäilmanpuhdistuslaitteet julkisiin tiloihin, kuten koulu- ja päiväkotitiloihin, toimistoihin, arkistoihin, auditorioihin jne. Tilaajat hankkivat pääosin vuokrattavia laitteita, ja vähäisissä määrin laitteita tullaan ostamaan omaksi. Ilmanpuhdistimilla haetaan väliaikaista ratkaisua sisäilmaongelmien hallintaan käyttöä turvaavana toimenpiteenä. Ilmanpuhdistimien tulee olla tarkoitettu tähän käyttötarkoitukseen. Hankinnan kohde on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön liitteellä 2 Palvelukuvaus. Kilpailutus suoritetaan avoimella menettelyllä, jonka perusteella jokaiseen osa-alueeseen puitetoimittajiksi valitaan kolme (3) vertailussa eniten pisteitä saanutta tarjoajaa etusijajärjestyksessä. Hankinta kilpailutetaan yhteishankintana niin, että Vantaan kaupunki julkaisee tarjouspyynnön. Kilpailutuksen perusteella tehdään samansisältöiset, sopimusluonnoksen (liite 1) mukaiset sopimukset Vantaan kaupungille, Kauniaisten kaupungille ja Vantaan ja Keravan hyvinvointialueelle. Hankintayksiköt tekevät myös oman päätöksensä. Vantaan kaupungille tehtävien sopimusten perusteella hankintoja voivat tehdä Vantaan kaupungin kaikki toimialat sekä Vantaan Tilapalvelut Vantti Oy, VTK Kiinteistöt Oy- konserni, VAV Yhtymä Oy, VAV Asunnot Oy, VAV Palvelukodit Oy, VAV Hoiva-asunnot Oy, Hakopolun Liikekiinteistö Oy, Kiinteistö Oy Hakucenter, Kiinteistö Oy Vantaan Maakotkantie 10, Pallastunturintien Liikekiinteistö Oy ja Asunto Oy Vantaan Katriinanrinne. Sopimustoimittaja voi tarjota samoin ehdoin tuotteitaan ja palvelujaan Vantaan kaupungin seuraaville konsernitoimijoille: Vivamus Kiinteistöt Oy ja Kiinteistö Oy Vantaan Sote-tilat. Sopimuskausi on kaksi (2) vuotta, jonka jälkeen sopimusta voidaan jatkaa kahdella (2) yhden (1) vuoden optiolla (1+1). Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa ilmoitettuihin euromääräisiin arvoihin tai tiettyihin arvioituihin hankintamääriin sopimuskaudella., Osa-alue 1: Puhtaanilmantuotto 160 m3/h Ilmanpuhdistuslaitteiden vuokraus ja hankinta toimistotiloihin., Osa-alue 2: Puhtaanilmantuotto 400 m3/h Ilmanpuhdistinten vuokraus ja hankinta., Osa-alue 3: Puhtaanilmantuotto 800 m3/h Ilmanpuhdistinten vuokraus ja hankinta isoihin tiloihin.,

title: Access Control and Intrusion Detection Services
description: The Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) requires the provision of parts and labour (technical support, programming, installation, service, and maintenance) on an “as and when requested” basis for its Integrated Security System (ISS) at CRA locations across Canada. The CRA is considering the conversion of up to 51 sites currently using a combination of Digital Security Controls (DSC) Intrusion Detection Systems and Kantech Access Control systems to a unified Kantech Intrusion/Access Control platform. The site counts identified below represent the CRA’s current intended conversion plans for planning and estimation purposes only and do not constitute a commitment to convert any specific number of sites. The CRA requires the goods and services referenced above in the following regions: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – up to 11 sites identified for potential conversion; 2. Ontario – up to 13 sites identified for potential conversion; 3. Quebec – up to 1 site identified for potential conversion; 4. Atlantic – up to 4 sites identified for potential conversion; and 5. Western – up to 22 sites identified for potential conversion. Bidders may submit a bid for one (1) or more Regions identified in this RFP. Only one (1) bid submission is required, regardless of the number of Regions for which the Bidder is submitting a bid. The Bidder's submission must clearly identify each Region for which it is proposing to provide the required goods and services. For each Region bid, the Bidder must provide all information required by this RFP, including any Region-specific technical information, resource information, and pricing, in the format prescribed in the bid solicitation documents. Requirement, project experience, certification, corporate qualification, or other bid components that are not Region-specific need only be submitted once and will be evaluated for all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. Bids for Multiple Regions: Requirements identified as Region-specific will be evaluated only for the applicable Region. Requirements that are not Region-specific will be evaluated once and will apply to all Regions included in the Bidder's submission. The CRA will evaluate each Region independently. Where a Bidder fails to meet a Region-specific requirement, the CRA may declare the bid non-responsive for that Region only. For greater certainty, a determination that a bid is non-responsive for one (1) Region will not, in itself, render the Bidder's submission non-responsive for any other Region for which a bid as been submitted, provided all applicable requirements for those Regions are met. The CRA intends to award up to five (5) contracts to fulfill this requirement. A Bidder may be awarded a contract for one (1) Region, multiple Regions, or all five (5) Regions. The period of the resulting contract(s) will be for three (3) firm years. The contract(s) will include four (4) irrevocable one-year options to extend the period of the contract(s). The contract(s) will also include provisions allowing the CRA to add, remove or modify products and sites. A bid must comply with the requirements of the bid solicitation and meet all mandatory evaluation criteria to be declared responsive. For each Region, the responsive bid with the highest combined rating of technical merit and price will be recommended for award of a contract. Each Region will be evaluated separately. Where the same Bidder is ranked first for multiple Regions, the CRA will award a single contract covering the Regions for which that Bidder is the highest-ranked responsive bidder. The Bid Compliance and Remedy Process (BCRP) defined in Part 4.2 will apply. Proposal documents and supporting information must be submitted in either English or French. Questions must be directed in writing to the contracting authority via email: Timothy.Berg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids must be submitted by using the Connect service provided by the Canada Post Corporation. When responding, the proposal MUST be delivered to: Canada Revenue Agency Bid Receiving Unit BRUg@cra-arc.gc.ca Bids will not be accepted if emailed directly to this email address. This email address must be used to request that CRA open a Connect conversation, as detailed in Standard Instructions 2003. Bidders must not use their own licensing agreement for Connect to initiate a Connect conversation with CRA. The CRA reserves the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. There are security requirements associated with this requirement. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The Federal Contractors Program (FCP) for employment equity applies to this procurement. This bid solicitation 1000536720/B cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number 1000536720/A dated 2026-03-27 with a closing of 2026-05-19 02:00 PM EDT. This solicitation is open only to Canadian suppliers and to Suppliers of an applicable trading partner. For additional information, consult the bid solicitation document. The CRA will include the following minimum work guarantees (all applicable taxes included) over the entire period of the resulting contract(s), which includes any exercised option periods, including any extension period thereof: 1. National Capital Region (NCR) – $100,000 CAD; 2. Ontario – $100,000 CAD; 3. Quebec – $50,000 CAD; 4. Atlantic – $50,000 CAD; and 5. Western – $100,000 CAD.

title: Steveston (Paramount) Utility Dike Crossings, Richmond, BC
description: Small Craft Harbours (SCH) requires the installation of underground High Density Polyethylene (HDPE) casings through an existing dike, at four (4) locations (Crossing A, B, C and D) in Steveston Paramount in preparation for future electrical and water underground installations. Summary of crossings are as follows: • Crossing A – 2 HDPE DR 17 450mm diameter for electrical and communication. • Crossing B – 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for waterline plus multiple tie ins to existing water pipe. • Crossing C – 2 HDPE DR 17 450mm diameter and 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for electrical, communication and waterline • Crossing D – 1 HDPE DR 11 300mm diameter for waterline. Crossing A and C require installation of electrical and communication pull box on both sides of the dike. Crossing B require re-routing water supply from the existing asbestos cement pipe to new HDPE DR 11 300mm watermain along Trites Road with multiple tie-ins to existing underground water line and into existing backflow preventor. Contractor shall provide all supervision, labour, materials, supplies, tools, equipment, transportation, quality control, health and safety practices, environmental protection, and all other necessary services for the proper and complete execution of the work. Work of this Contract is located at 12740 Trites Road, Richmond, BC, Canada Familiarization with site: Before submitting a bid, bidders can visit the site and its surroundings, at their own expense, to review and verify the form, nature, and extent of the work, materials needed for the completion of the work, the means of access to the site, severity, exposure, and uncertainty of weather, soil conditions, any accommodations they may require, and in general shall obtain all necessary information as to risks, contingencies, and other circumstances which may influence or affect their bid. No allowance shall be made subsequently in this connection on account or error or negligence to properly observe and determine the conditions that will apply. Timeline: All work including clean-up and demobilization must be completed by March 31, 2027.

title: Purchase of One (1) Liquid Chromatography System
description: Tendering Procedures: Invitation to tenders following instructions on the Supply Arrangement Competitive Procurement Strategy: Contract against the SA will be awarded to the supplier responding to all mandatory technical criteria and with the lowest price. Comprehensive Land Claim Agreement: No Nature of Requirements: Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, SA E60PV-19EQUI for the purchase of : One (1) Liquid Chromatography System Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, Kentville Research and Development Centre THIS REQUEST IS RESERVED FOR HOLDERS OF SUPPLY ARRANGEMENT # E60PV-19EQUI ONLY, FOR THE PURCHASE OF LABORATORY AND SCIENTIFIC EQUIPMENT, PARTS AND ACCESSORIES, SERVICES AND SUPPLIES. Only Suppliers currently pre-qualified on Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI have been invited to bid. As a requirement of the Supply Arrangement, this notice is published on Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) for a period of 40 calendar days. The closing date published on this notice identifies how long the notice will be published. For the closing date of any solicitation under the supply arrangement, invited suppliers should refer to the solicitation documents. Suppliers that do not have a Supply Arrangement for the supply of Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies with Public Works and Government Services Canada, cannot submit a bid. Any bids received from suppliers not pre-qualified on the Supply Arrangement will not be evaluated. Suppliers may qualify under Supply Arrangement E60PV-19EQUI for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies, at any time. Interested suppliers should download solicitation document E60PV-19EQUI/D from CanadaBuys (SAP Ariba) and submit a response as per the requirements of the Request for Supply Arrangement. The responsive bidder already holding a Supply arrangement for Laboratory and Scientific Equipment, Parts and Accessories, Services and Supplies from Public Works and Government Services Canada who meets the mandatory technical criteria with the lowest aggregate price will be recommended for contract award. The mandatory technical criteria are: Liquid Chromatography (LC) System a. The LC system must be supplied with an LC solution suitable for proteomics, such as a nano-flow LC system for peptide sample preparation and separation, designed for seamless coupling to the MS. The system must operate at flow rates ranging from at least 200 nL/min to 100 µL/min and must not require a flow splitter. b. The LC system must have the maximum operating pressure at least to 15,000 psi. c. The LC system must be capable of operating within a pH range of 2–10. d. The LC system must support two-dimensional (2D) LC analysis, including an auxiliary solvent and trap valve manager, a column-trapping pump, nano-Lock spray capability, primary check valves, column compartment, and switching valves configured for 2D operation. All primary wetted materials must be included. e. The LC system must support unattended operation, with full diagnostic data display for up to 96 hours through the control software. f. The LC system must include solvent storage, with a solvent tray capable of accommodating up to three (3) eluents. g. The LC system must include a micro-binary solvent delivery system, supporting solvents A1 or A2 and B1 or B2, and must provide solvent conditioning, gradient formation, primary check valves, compressibility compensation, and automatic priming. Pump compositional precision must be < 0.25% RSD based on repeated injections. The system must be equipped with an integrated, programmable active wash system to flush the rear of the high-pressure seals. h. The LC system must include a sample handling system with an injection volume range from 0.1 µL to 100 µL, with 5 µL standard injection, supporting 1, 2, 5, 20, 50, and 100 µL injection options, and unlimited volume for trapping. The system must have full-loop and partial-loop injection modes. The autosampler must accommodate 96- or 48-position sample plates with 2.0 mL vials and include a temperature-controlled autosampler (4.0–40.0 °C) with high temperature accuracy and stability. The system must have a column chamber (temperature controlled). i. All equipment must be certified or approved for use in accordance with the Canadian Electrical Code; j. The LC system must be CSA certified upon delivery.

title: Belgium – Energy-management services – ENERGY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM FOR BPOST SA/NV
description: Bpost wishes to implement a future-oriented solution for monitoring, managing and intelligently controlling the energy Bpost wishes to implement a future-oriented solution for monitoring, managing and intelligently controlling the energy flows within some of its buildings, operational sites and logistics infrastructure in Belgium (approximately 100 locations). The contract aims to implement a scalable, secure and future-proof solution that supports Bpost in optimizing its energy consumption, reducing energy costs and realizing its sustainability and electrification strategy. (See: https://bnode.com/sustainability ) This assignment is part of the further roll-out of the energy transition within Bpost, in which the number of electric vehicles, charging infrastructures, battery storage systems and renewable energy sources will increase significantly in the coming years. The selected solution must be able to monitor, manage and, where applicable, intelligently control the various energy assets in an integrated and safe manner, so that an optimal energy balance is achieved while respecting the technical limitations of the installations, the capacity tariffs, available capacities and the operational needs of Bpost.

title: Belgium – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – CEFTA TRACES NT Maintenance, Expansion and SPS Digital Systems Support
description: Maintenance, support and expansion of CEFTA TRACES NT and related SPS digital systems. CEFTA TRACES NT is a digital platform supporting the electronic processing and exchange of phytosanitary certificates, veterinary health certificates, CHED-like documents, pharmaceutical permits and notifications on non-compliant consignments. The platform supports traceability, information exchange and risk management in the sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) area. The contract will also support interoperability with local systems and relevant international platforms, as well as gradual alignment with the EU IMSOC approach, including TRACES NT, RASFF/iRASFF, EUROPHYT and ADIS-related functionalities, where relevant.

title: Belgium – Research, testing and scientific technical simulator – Ontwikkeling van een onderzoeksgericht windgeneratiesysteem voor het
description: Deze opdracht heeft betrekking op de ontwikkeling, levering en installatie van een onderzoeksgericht windgeneratiesysteem voor het Coastal & Ocean Basin Oostende Het Coastal & Ocean Basin (COB) is gevestigd in het Maritiem Onderzoekscentrum van de Vlaamse Overheid in Oostende (UGent Ostend Science Park). Het is ontworpen om het effect van golven en stromingen op kustwaterbouwkundige constructies en offshore/drijvende installaties te bestuderen, zoals het nieuwe energie-eiland in de Noordzee of op de natuur gebaseerde oplossingen voor erosiebescherming rond de fundering van offshore windturbines. Ook het hydrodynamische en constructieve gedrag van nieuwe technologieën voor hernieuwbare energieopwekking op zee wordt hier onderzocht (b.v. golfenergieconvertoren, drijvende zonnepanelen op zee, drijvende windturbines). Het Coastal & Ocean Basin verwelkomt gebruikers uit de industrie, de academische wereld en overheidsinstellingen.

title: Belgium – Advertising campaign services – MARCHÉ PUBLIC CONCERNANT LE RENOUVELLEMENT DE LA CAMPAGNE D’INFORMATION ET DE SENSIBILISATION « PARLONS-EN » SUR LES SOINS DE SANTÉ MENTALE PRIS EN CHARGE PAR L'ASSURANCE MALADIE OBLIGATOIRE
description: PHASE DE SÉLECTION : Ce marché porte sur la préparation, l'élaboration, la planification et la mise en œuvre d'une campagne qui s'inscrit dans la continuité de la campagne « Parlons-en ». Cette campagne a pour objectif de briser le tabou entourant la santé mentale (à savoir que les soins psychologiques ne sont pas réservés aux personnes souffrant de « graves troubles mentaux » et que les personnes ne doivent pas être amenées à résoudre seules leurs problèmes psychologiques), d’informer sur l’efficacité des séances de groupe et des interventions communautaires, de faire connaître l’offre de soins psychologiques de première ligne remboursés et d’encourager des groupes cibles spécifiques à parler de leurs problèmes psychologiques avec un psychologue clinicien et/ou un orthopédagogue conventionné. Les prescriptions techniques complètes du présent marché seront contenues dans le cahier spécial des charges qui sera transmis aux candidats sélectionnés au terme de la phase de sélection.

title: Joinery Contractors Framework
description: NHS Lanarkshire Health Board (“the Board”) invites suitably qualified and experienced contractors to tender for appointment to the NHSL329-26 Joinery Contractors Framework. The framework will support the Property & Support Services Division in delivering planned, reactive, routine and emergency joinery works across NHS Lanarkshire’s healthcare estate. The framework will comprise three lots: Lot 1: University Hospital Monklands, works below GBP 5,000 - Lot 1 covers planned, routine, reactive and emergency joinery works valued below GBP 5,000 at University Hospital Monklands. Lot 2: Community Sites, works below GBP 5,000 - Lot 2 covers planned, routine, reactive and emergency joinery works valued below GBP 5,000 across the NHS Lanarkshire community sites listed in Appendix A of the Specification. Requirements will normally be awarded through quotation or mini-competition, with the applicable award criteria and quality-to-price weighting confirmed for each requirement. The framework will operate for an initial period of 24 months, with the option to extend for a further two 12-month periods. Contractors must provide a safe, reliable and responsive service that supports clinical operations.

title: Protein ENGineering (PENG)
description: The Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) is soliciting innovative proposals for the development of a multifunctional, target-agnostic platform for precise, programmable editing of endogenous proteins. The goal of the Protein ENGineering (PENG) program is to transition proteome engineering from a collection of isolated, bespoke tools into a universal, software-defined discipline. The PENG program will establish a comprehensive, integrated platform composed of modular targeting, generalizable effector chemistries, and multiplexed control systems. Rather than developing isolated, target-specific tools, performers will integrate novel splicing, ligation, and co-translational techniques to directly recognize, modify, and rewrite endogenous proteins within complex biological architectures. Performers may explore multiple technical paths, progressively advancing their approaches from foundational validation to robust demonstrations of efficacy. Ultimately, this integrated platform will be validated in high-fidelity cellular models (e.g., organoids), to provide an integrated proof-of-concept at the tissue level.

title: Broad Agency Announcement (BAA): Cost Estimating Modeling Data, Analytics Research (CEMDAR)
description: Broad Agency Announcement (BAA) Closed Two-Step BAA: SAF/FM Cost Estimating Modeling Data Analytics Research (CEMDAR) The Two-Step Process reduces acquisition resources for both the Government and industry. Section I � Program Description & Strategic Objectives The Department of the Air Force (DAF) has identified critical operational gaps in the enterprise databases, analytical methods, and predictive tools regularly employed for weapon system cost estimating and analysis. DAF is actively committed to modernizing the efficiency, fidelity, and throughput of its cost estimating capabilities. This requirement invests in strengthening, accelerating, and elevating cost data and analytic capabilities using modern data science and cloud engineering technologies to enable faster, higher-quality, and higher-volume analytic decision support across the DAF cost community. The CEMDAR research initiative executes four fundamental architectural shifts across enterprise cost operations: Platform Modernization: Transitioning from legacy desktop-based analytical tools to secure enterprise cloud platforms (e.g., DAF Data Fabric, VAULT, Envision). Relational Data Integration: Moving from isolated, commodity-specific datasets to integrated, relational architectures linking programmatic, technical, cost, and schedule parameters. Pipeline Automation: Replacing static spreadsheets and recurring manual reporting with dynamic, automated data engineering pipelines. Scalable Predictive Modeling: Advancing from low-volume static cost modeling to highly scalable data collection, curation, machine learning, and empirical analytics. 2.1 Strategic Research Objectives Elevating Data Fidelity: Improving the verifiable quality, authenticity, granularity, and volume of empirical data collected and accessible to DAF cost analysts. Relational Enterprise Databases: Engineering centralized, enterprise-level relational cost, schedule, and technical databases adhering to rigorous data science principles and MIL-STD-881 standards. Analytical Workflow Optimization: Constructing capabilities and streamlined workflows that empower analysts to rapidly synthesize large-scale multi-commodity datasets. title: Two Phase Design and Construction of the Port Monmouth Phase II, Contract 1 Mitigation Project
description: As of 18 September 2026: RTA 30% Package broken up and uploaded due to SAM size limitation. As of 17 September 2026: Phase I of a Two Phase BVTO posted. The Port Monmouth project consists of shore protection components (Phase 1) as well as flood risk management components (Phase II). The project provides for reduction of storm damages to low-lying residential and commercial structures from coastal erosion, tidal flooding, and inland flooding along Pews and Compton Creeks caused by high surface events in Raritan Bay. Phase II flood risk management components consist of a tide gate, levees, floodwalls, two pump stations, three road closure structures, road raising and regarding, and wetland mitigation. The State of New Jersey, acting through the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP), is the non-Federal sponsor for the project.

description: NOTICE TYPE: REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) DATE: 17 SEPTEMBER 2026 Miniature Multiple Threat Emitter System (Mini-MUTES) AN/MST-T1 (V)Miniature Multiple Threat Emitter System (Mini-MUTES) AN/MST-T1 (V) 1.0 DESCRIPTION THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes � it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request for information does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the U.S. Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Responders are advised that the U.S. Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI; all costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party�s expense. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. If a solicitation is released, it will be synopsized on Sam.gov. It is the responsibility of the potential offerors to monitor this site for additional information pertaining to this requirement. The 415 Supply Chain Management Squadron (SCMS) � Air Force (AF) � is looking for more sources that can manufacture and repair a gearbox used on the AN/MST?T1 (V) Mini-MUTES system. The Air Force (AF) owns a full technical data package (TDP) required to produce this gearbox. The 415 SCMS is also seeking recommendations on how to harden the gears using different materials and hardening methods. NSN: 3010-01-315-5148 Part number: 200927771 Noun: Gear Box Assembly Cage: 98747 2.0 BACKGROUND The AN/MST?T1 (V) Threat Emitter System relies on a specialized gearbox that has historically been supported through an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM). As the OME�s capability diminished, the Air Force (AF) is seeking a qualified supplier capable of producing and repairing the gearbox using the complete technical data package (TDP) already in possession. Modernizing sustainment for this component also includes evaluating improved gear hardening materials and processes to increase durability, reduce wear, and extend service life under operational loads. Requests for the technical data package (TDP) can be sent to the contracting officer and contracting specialist identified in section 4 of this RFI. Requests must have a copy of your company�s DD 2345 (Militarily Critical Technical Data Agreement) and Joint Certification Program (JCP) registration. 3.0 REQUESTED INFORMATION Please provide company information such as cage code, points of contact and socioeconomic status (small business, large business, SDVOSB, etc.). Can you describe your relevant capability and/or past performance on similar items? What materials will be required for fabrication? Which hardening process will be applied? What is the estimated production time for a single unit? What is the rough order of magnitude (ROM) cost, including non-recurring engineering (NRE), unit production and sustainment? 4.0 RESPONSES Interested parties are requested to respond to this RFI by answering the questions in Section 3.0. Please provide responses along with name, mailing address, phone number and e-mail address of the designated point of contact. All responses are voluntary. All responses shall be submitted to the Procuring Contracting Officer (PCO), and Contracting Specialist (CS). Contracting Officer: Cydnee Simpson, cydnee.simpson@us.af.mil Contracting Specialist: Nicholas Standiford, nicholas.standiford@us.af.mil The Government is seeking responses by 19 October 2026 @ 12:00 PM MST. 5.0 SUMMARY THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. The information provided in the RFI is subject to change and is not binding on the Government. The US Government has not made a commitment to procure Mini-MUTEs ANMST-T1 V, and release of this RFI should not be construed as such a commitment or as authorization to incur cost for which reimbursement would be required or sought.

title: Two Phase Design and Construction of the Port Monmouth Phase II, Contract 1 Mitigation Project
description: As of 18 September 2026: RTA 30% Package broken up and uploaded due to SAM size limitation. As of 17 September 2026: Phase I of a Two Phase BVTO posted. The Port Monmouth project consists of shore protection components (Phase 1) as well as flood risk management components (Phase II). The project provides for reduction of storm damages to low-lying residential and commercial structures from coastal erosion, tidal flooding, and inland flooding along Pews and Compton Creeks caused by high surface events in Raritan Bay. Phase II flood risk management components consist of a tide gate, levees, floodwalls, two pump stations, three road closure structures, road raising and regarding, and wetland mitigation. The State of New Jersey, acting through the New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP), is the non-Federal sponsor for the project.

title: Z2DA--589A7-23-306 Renovate Bldg. 5 & 5B for Mental Health FY27 NRM
description: Contractor shall perform construction and renovation of the existing space in Building 5 &/or 5B at the Robert J. Dole VA Medical Center campus. This project will prepare approximately 1,100 SF of existing space in building 5 and/or 5B for use as a same day access mental health clinic in adherence to VHA directive 1231(2) & VHA Handbook 1160.1. This project shall be executed in a manner, following the sequence defined in the design narrative, to maintain continuous operations of adjacent VA clinical functions and medical center functionality throughout construction. All construction work shall be performed in full compliance with the complete set of bidding documents, including all contract drawings, specifications, and design narratives associated with this solicitation necessary to convert the existing space into four exam rooms, a combined waiting/reception area, a relocated police office, and associated support spaces. The general contractor shall furnish all labor, supervision, materials, tools, and equipment necessary to execute the required scope of work. Construction will consist of, but is not limited to, the following: � Selective demolition of existing interior partitions, ceilings, finishes, and elements required for new clinic layout. � Installation of new interior finishes including flooring, wall finishes, ceilings, trim, and casework. � Implementation of therapeutic design features, including calm color schemes, anchored artwork, secure hardware, and achieving a minimum STC-45 acoustic rating for exam room partitions. � Installation of new wall-mounted lavatories in each exam room. Routing new domestic hot and cold water from adjacent restrooms and trenching new water lines across the corridor to existing tin-in points. � Rebalancing and modifying HVAC systems; reusing the existing rooftop AHU serving the building; relocating or adding diffusers/grilles; installing ligature-resistant diffusers in exam rooms � Providing new electrical receptacles, data outlets, and circuits to support clinical functions � Installing LED lighting including secured, ligature-resistant fixtures in exam rooms; relocating or supplementing lighting in general spaces; adding occupancy sensors. � Removal of existing sprinklers, providing temporary upright sprinkler coverage during construction, and installing new sprinklers to meet NFPA 13 standards Statement of Work for Project 589A7-23-306, Renovate 5 & 5B for Mental Health July 08, 2026 2 � Site preparation for installation of Government?furnished equipment, including structural supports, utility connections, and required interfaces. � Hazardous materials abatement, including asbestos remediation in areas identified during construction; asbestos?containing materials are expected in some work areas and must be removed or handled per applicable VA, EPA, OSHA, and state/local regulations. � All other items as described in the contract documents. This construction work is located in an occupied, operational clinical facility and must be performed in a manner that allows medical care services to continue uninterrupted throughout construction, This requires carefully phased construction, strict adherence to ICRA, infection control, noise/vibration limits, and daily coordination with the VA COR and end users. Construction may also include the abatement of any asbestos as identified on the provided drawings. The construction of this project will take place in a very busy occupied building and is to be completed to allow medical care functions to be maintained uninterrupted throughout construction � necessitating carefully phased construction and coordination with VA COR/users, including strict adherence to ICRA requirements.

title: Maintenance, Repair, and Preservation of YRBM-50
description: 17 September 2026- Reason for amendment 0001 is to add additional ship check date, extend the deadline for clarifications and solicitation end date. See section L. ________________________________ The Regional Maintenance Center at Puget Sound Naval Shipyard and Intermediate Maintenance Facility (PSNS and IMF) intends to award a stand-alone Firm-Fixed-Price contract to accomplish maintenance, repair, and preservation of YRBM-50. The YRBM-50 characteristics are Length: 153FT, Width: 43FT, Age: 82 Years, Hull Type: Steel, Draft: 6FT, Full Displacement: 900 L Tons and Light Load: 427 L Tons. The Contractors facility must possess the capability of YRBM-50 with the dimensions as stated above. To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the West Coast of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. Scope Overview: Coordinate with the Contracting Officer, via the SUPERVISOR to deliver the vessel to the Contractors facility. To facilitate proper government oversight, the facility where the work will be performed shall be located in the Puget Sound, WA region. For this procurement, the Puget Sound, WA region is defined as the west of the continental US, starting from Olympia, WA and extending northward to Bellingham, WA. Upon docking vessel, wash, and clean vessel. Accomplish required inspections and fender repairs. Remove existing and install new zinc anodes. Hull, freeboard and exterior decks require ultrasonic measurement of plating thickness and repair of areas below minimum thickness as needed. Accomplish blast and paint preservation of hull, freeboard, exterior decks and superstructure. Vessel requires inspection for damage and deterioration (hull, exterior decks, and tanks/voids plating and framing). Apply new non-skid system to exterior decks. Open, clean, ventilate, inspect, test, and maintain dry each tank/void. Accomplish partial preservation of QTY (24 EA) ballast tanks/voids. Accomplish access cover and watertight hatch and door repairs. Disinfect and certify potable water system. Pump and clean the interior surfaces of the CHT tank. Accomplish main deck repairs, hawse hole bulls eye and bolster repairs, and hull fendering system modifications. Accomplish the following modifications: hot water heater installation, awning replacement, A/C plant replacement and backup systems, switchboard upgrades, 1MC replacement and phone system upgrades, and CCTV upgrades. Undock the vessel. Verify vessel drawings and provide redline drawings to reflect actual conditions of the vessel. Conduct dock trials. Coordinate with the SUPERVISOR to support and accomplish all contract requirements prior to the availability end date. Arrange and coordinate the delivery of the vessel back to the Government with the Contracting Officer via the SUPERVISOR. Specific details of all work items and tasks required by the Statement of Work described in this Scope Overview are included in Section 3.0 of the Statement of Work. The vessel availability is scheduled to be 31 March 2027 through 31 March 2028. This is a 100% Small Business set-aside under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) 336611, size standard 1,300 employees. All offerors must be registered with the System for Award Management (SAM) to receive award of Government contracts. Offerors are advised also that SAM representations and certifications can be completed electronically via the System for Award Management website at https://www.sam.gov.

title: AN/BYG-1 Applications
description: Description SOLICITATION ANNOUNCEMENT: AN/BYG-1 APPLICATIONS The Department of the Navy, Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA), on behalf of the Portfolio Acquisition Executive for Undersea (PAE Undersea) and the Director, Submarine Programs (DSP), is releasing the formal solicitation for the AN/BYG-1 Applications requirement from the Submarine Combat and Weapons Control Program Office (PMS 425). This notice follows the previously published Draft Request for Proposal (RFP) and Industry Day event. The Government has reviewed the feedback received during and after the Industry Day and has revised the requirements accordingly for this final solicitation. SCOPE OF THE REQUIREMENT (GENERAL OVERVIEW) AN/BYG-1 is the U.S. Navy�s Submarine Combat Control System. The AN/BYG-1 provides tools for the analysis of surface, sub-surface, and airborne contacts operating in the vicinity of own-ship and within the mission theater. This analysis supports command and decision-making, payload and attack control functions, determination of ballistic data for legacy torpedoes, and initiation of firing sequence for all payload types in support of submarine mission areas. The scope of this solicitation encompasses the development, testing, integration, delivery, logistics, and full-lifecycle sustainment of compiled AN/BYG-1 software baselines. This includes current, future, and legacy AN/BYG-1 applications as part of a modernized capability delivery framework. Key objectives and technical efforts under this contract include: Deliver AN/BYG-1 capabilities and baselines in alignment with Submarine Tactical Requirements Group priorities Decouple AN/BYG-1 applications from hardware and software dependencies Implement microcontainer/microservices AN/BYG-1 architecture Transform AN/BYG-1 development and test environments by increasing virtualization and establishing a common, shared infrastructure Develop and integrate tactical decision aids that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies Assist with the design, development, and integration of combat control system elements to support international cooperative agreements and joint programs. ACCESS TO SOLICITATION DOCUMENTS AND CLASSIFIED DATA The AN/BYG-1 Applications solicitation, Statement of Work (SOW), and associated unclassified attachments are designated as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and will not be posted directly to SAM.gov. These documents will be made available exclusively via the secure Electronic Technical Information Center (E-TIC) portal hosted by the Advanced Interactive Management Technology Center (AIMTC). Additionally, portions of the Government Furnished Information, specifically, the classified software source code provided to support proposal development are classified at the SECRET level and will be transmitted physically. Documents made available during this procurement may contain classified data and/or technical data whose export is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act. Foreign participation shall be limited by applicable legal authorities, regulations, and other security classification requirements as specified in the DD Form 254. Consolidated Access Request Instructions Prospective Offerors must submit a single, consolidated access request email to the Points of Contact listed below to obtain E-TIC portal access and the classified GFI software package. Email Attachments Required: DD Form 254: A completed copy of the DD Form 254. title: USACE - Industry Day 2026
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Middle East District, will host an in-person and virtual Industry Day on 22 October 2026. Check-in on the day of the event will begin at 0730. Tentative agenda will include a Contracting and Programs overview along with a focused session on the upcoming Qatar Development of Al Udeid (QDA) program and an upcoming Space Campus project that is anticipated to be awarded via a new delivery method called Integrated Design and Construction (IDaC). There will be an opportunity for breakout sessions and a question & answer (Q&A) session with Contracting, Construction, Engineering, and Programs and Project Management. The location will be the DoubleTree by Hilton, Blue Ridge Shadows, 111 Hospitality Drive, Front Royal, VA 22630. The purpose of Industry Day is for our architect-engineer and general contractor partners to have a glimpse of the current and upcoming program opportunities in the CENTCOM Area of Responsibility (AOR) to allow both USACE and our contractor community to be better prepared for the work ahead. There will be an opportunity to openly discuss any questions, comments, concerns, and best practices contractors have about working in the CENTCOM AOR during the Q&A session. The Middle East District will solicit questions from industry in advance of the event. Please submit any questions by 1600 Eastern Daylight Time, 16 October 2025 to the attention of Jeanette Farrell at Jeanette.M.Farrell@usace.army.mil, with the Subject Line: Industry Day Oct 2026. Questions will be evaluated, and responses provided during the Q&A portion of the event. All attendees are required to register online to provide their company name and attendee names with titles by 19 October 2026. Please register using the following hyperlink: https://events.dod.teams.microsoft.us/event/e963de64-91e6-4c99-9f20-cf582117491c@fc4d76ba-f17c-4c50-b9a7-8f3163d27582?source=copyLinkLegacyShareLinkDialog When entering the meeting via MS Teams, please enter as a guest utilizing the email provided during registration. We are currently not limiting in-person attendance at the event; however, this may change if an overwhelming number of companies intend to send representatives. A questionnaire is included for the submittal with RSVP. There is no cost to attend this event. Presentation slides will be provided prior to the event. For questions regarding this event, please feel free to contact Jeanette Farrell at the email address shown above.
